# MEETING MINUTES OF: March 18, 2026

A meeting of the Cemetery Board of Trustees was held at the Forest Dale Cemetery, 150 Forest Street, Malden on the above date, in accordance with the Notice of Meeting, as provided in G.L. c.30A,§§ 18-25. Notice was filed with the City Clerk's Office, City of Malden.

President James Tuxbury called the meeting to order at 5:00 P.M. Members present were James Tuxbury, Vincent Miraglia and Joseph Barriss.

**APPROVAL OF MINUTES:** The minutes of the February 18, 2026 meeting were read and upon the motion of Vincent Miraglia and seconded by Joseph Barriss, the Board voted to accept the minutes as read; all were in
CARRIED

**CORRESPONDENCE:** None

**TREASURER REPORT:** Cemetery Superintendent Chris Rosa provided the following information: The Cemetery Trust received income for the month of February the amount of $11,181.83 for Perpetual Care. This money was turned over to the Treasurer's office to be added to the Cemetery Trust accounts. Upon the motion of Joseph Barriss and seconded by Vincent Miraglis, the Board voted to accept the Trust Report as read; all were in favor.
CARRIED

**SUPERINTENDENT'S REPORT:** The Superintendent's report was received by the Trustees. Superintendent Rosa provided the following information: burials for the month of January were two (2)) full burials in existing lots; one (1) single new grave and two (2) new two-grave burials for a total of five (5) burials.
The motion to accept Superintendent's report was made by Joseph Barriss and seconded by Vincent Miraglia; all were in favor. CARRIED

**OLD BUSINESS/GENERAL CEMETERY BUSINESS:** Continued discussion on possible future expansion in the Cemetery, with limited availability. Discussions will continue at a future meeting.

**Next meeting of the Board of Trustees:** The next meeting of the Cemetery Board of Trustees will be held on Wednesday, April 15 2026.

**ADJOURMENT:** All business before the Board of Trustees having been completed and upon motion of Joseph Barriss and seconded by Vinnie Miraglia, the meeting was adjourned at 5:45 P.M.

Respectfully submitted,

Sheila Fermano, Secretary

James Tuxbury, President
Sheila L. Fermano, Secretary
Joseph Barris, Trustee
Vincent Miraglia, Trustee

TRUSTEES of CEMETERIES
City of Malden
150 Forest Street, Malden, MA 02148
781-322-2360
headline: Accepted the Treasurer's and Superintendent's reports while continuing discussion on possible future cemetery expansion.
summary: The board reviewed the February 18, 2026 minutes, a Treasurer's report showing $11,181.83 in Perpetual Care income for February, and a Superintendent's report listing five burials in January. Members continued discussion on possible future cemetery expansion due to limited availability, with no decision reached. The next meeting was set for Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
